content.title: ‘Lioness’ to close street in Fort Worth’s Cultural District for season 3 filming
content.text: Taylor Sheridan’s “Lioness” will close a street in Fort Worth’s Cultural District next week.The Paramount+ series began production on its third season in Cowtown in October 2025. The show has already filmed in and around the city, including in north Fort Worth at SGS Studios, in downtown at Wicked Butcher and in the University West neighborhood near TCU.Part of South University Drive and a majority of University Drive will be impacted by filming on March 24 and 25.Here’s what to know.“Lioness” is closing part of South University Drive and all of University Drive between West Lancaster Avenue and West Freeway, according to a city street use permit.The stretch of University will be fully closed from 5 a.m. to 7 p.m. on March 24 and 25. “Lioness” will film driving, stunt and collision scenes during those days.Fort Worth police will be on-site to facilitate traffic and all local residents/businesses will have access to their properties at all times, per the permit. Once filming wraps, traffic operations will return to normal.Speaking of traffic, the Fort Worth Botanic Garden announced Monday that its main entrance on University Drive will be closed on March 24 and 25 due to a “special event.”During those two days, guests will not be able to enter through the University Drive gate. Instead, all guests will need to enter and exit through the Trail Drive gate, which is accessible from Montgomery Street.The garden will remain open from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. on those days, with the last ticket sold at 5 p.m. The “Butterflies in the Garden” interactive event will also continue from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., with the last ticket sold at 4 p.m. Zoe Saldana as Joe in “Lioness,” episode 8, season 2, streaming on Paramount+, 2024. Ryan Green Paramount+ More on ‘Lioness’“Lioness” follows CIA operative Joe (Zoe Saldaña) as she balances her “personal and professional lives as the tip of the spear in the agency’s war on terror.”Season 1 filmed in Maryland, Delaware, Washington D.C., Paris and Mallorca, Spain. For season 2, the series primarily filmed in and around North Texas, including in Fort Worth, Weatherford, Strawn, Stephenville and Glen Rose.In addition to Saldaña, “Lioness” stars Nicole Kidman, Morgan Freeman, Laysla De Oliveira, Genesis Rodriguez, Michael Kelly, Dave Annable, James Jordan, Ian Bohen, Jill Wagner, LaMonica Garrett, Austin Hébert, Jonah Wharton, Thad Luckinbill and Hannah Love Lanier.“Lioness” seasons 1 and 2 are streaming on Paramount+.This story was originally published March 17, 2026 at 1:21 PM. Brayden GarciaFort Worth Star-Telegram Brayden Garcia is a service journalism reporter at the Fort Worth Star-Telegram. He is part of a team of local journalists who answer reader questions and write about life in North Texas. Brayden mainly writes about weather and all things Taylor Sheridan-related.
